scope: GitHub Issues as a ticket source: one github.com repository with label, assignee, milestone and state filters saved in Settings; on-request paginated sync of plain issues (pull requests excluded) through the provider-neutral source model; re-sync identity matching and re-acceptance on title/body change; GitHub open/closed as source status only; truthful not connected / unreadable / rejected / no access (not installed) / issues disabled / rate limited / unreachable / filter states. Per-project source selection is FOR-47; delivery back to GitHub is FOR-48.

simulated.provider: Loopback GitHub API fixtures (axum in crates/crewroom-service/tests/github_issues.rs; std TcpListener in crates/crewroom-desktop/src/workbench/github_issues_tests.rs); not github.com.
checks: Fresh workspace reports githubIssues not_configured; sync before a source is saved is refused (409); malformed sources (bad repository, unknown state, extra field) are refused (400)
Saved filters reach GitHub: labels, assignee, milestone title resolved to its number through /milestones, state, per_page=100
Sync without a connection records reason not_connected and imports nothing

Sync follows Link rel="next" to a second page, excludes the pull request, imports #1/#3/#4 with sourceStatus open/closed, sourceSite, sourceId, sourceUrl, project and sourceUpdatedAt; no run is created
After the operator refines #1, a changed title re-syncs into the same ticket with sourceRevision 2, needsReacceptance true and the brief kept
Rate limit (403 with x-ratelimit-remaining 0) records reason rate_limited with GitHub's reset time; the last complete sync time and tickets are kept
404 records no_access with the not-installed/not-granted explanation; 410 records issues_disabled; a revoked token records rejected

Core: closing an issue changes source status without re-acceptance; older observations, pull requests and duplicates save nothing; a sync or failure for a replaced source is refused or ignored; schema-31 stores gain the github_sync table
Runtime: next-page links on another origin are refused so the token is not sent elsewhere

Desktop: Settings → Integrations → GitHub Issues saves a source, states the missing connection, connects, syncs, and the ticket list shows 'GitHub open' / 'GitHub closed'; a GitHub ticket's facts bar shows 'GITHUB STATUS' / 'open' apart from workflow and agent activity

live.endpoint: https://api.github.com through a debug crewroomd built from the implementation revision 6a495e5 (sha256 81d7dd440463e1618e59c1fd28531a36bd46a60cd847037a4e418de12bcf9f5d), loopback port 4359, isolated temporary --data-dir (deleted afterwards)
live.repository: Operator-approved private sandbox <owner>/crewroom-e2e-sandbox. Synthetic issues #3 (open), #4 (closed) and #5 (unlabelled) were created for this run with label for-45-intake and milestone 'FOR-45 synthetic'; issue #1 and pull request #2 belong to FOR-46's probe.
live.credential: CREWROOM_GITHUB_TOKEN set from the operator's gh CLI login token in the daemon environment only; never printed. It is a gh OAuth token, not a fine-grained or classic PAT.
live.redaction: Repository owner replaced with <owner>. No token is retained.
